description: Header file defining the SystemInfo class and related interfaces for system information retrieval, including environment variables, hardware details, and memory snapshots within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Provides system information such as hostname, memory, CPU load, environment variables, and system identifiers, with singleton access and memory snapshot capabilities.

classes.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot
classes.description: Encapsulates a snapshot of system memory statistics, with JSON formatting of memory data.

classes.name: IService
classes.description: Interface for system services with metadata, creation, and navigation capabilities.

classes.name: IService::IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing metadata about a service, including name, module, and version numbers.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Generates a device ID based on raw device ID bytes and a key length.

methods.name: GetEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable value by name.

methods.name: SetEnvironment
methods.description: Sets environment variable value by name, with options for forced update.

methods.name: GetPhysicalPageCount
methods.description: Calculates total number of physical pages.

methods.name: GetTotalSwap
methods.description: Returns total swap space in bytes.

methods.name: GetFreeSwap
methods.description: Returns free swap space in bytes.

methods.name: AsJSON
methods.description: Returns memory snapshot data as JSON string.
